question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Lament
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**, i.e., "Rejoice".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Lament"** means to express sorrow, grief, or regret, often in a deep or emotional manner. (विलाप करना, शोक व्यक्त करना)

 
 
• **Example:** She lamented the loss of her childhood home, which was full of cherished memories.
 
 
 
• **"Rejoice"** means to feel or show great joy or delight, which is the opposite of lament. (आनंदित होना, खुश होना)
 
 
• **Example:** The family rejoiced when they heard the good news about their son's promotion.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the antonym of **'Lament'** is **'Rejoice'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Part** (भाग): A piece or segment of something.

 
 
• **Example:** This part of the book is my favorite because it reveals the mystery.
 
 
 
• **Refuse** (मना करना): To decline or reject something.
 
 
• **Example:** He refused the invitation to the party due to prior commitments.
 
 
 
• **Grieve** (शोक करना): To feel deep sorrow or distress, especially due to the loss of someone or something.
 
 
• **Example:** She grieved for months after the passing of her beloved pet.
